{{Quote|Nothing better than a douse of Derellium's finest after a long day's work, eh?''"<br />"''Particularly after all the work is done.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Keldrath]] and [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], in the [[Holoplay/Legends|holoplay]] ''[[Xim at Vontor]]''|<ref name="XaV">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek04/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part III: Xim at Vondor)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>}}
'''Derellium''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
A leading [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], Derellium is famous locally for its [[Wine/Legends|wines]]. Some Cronese wine collections include [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old [[Derellium Wine|Derellium vintages]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

==History==
One of the original member-[[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], it was absorbed into [[Xim's empire]]. After the empire collapsed, it would continue to thrive as a world of the Kingdom of Cron, eventually being part of the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

In the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] final [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Tion Cluster worlds joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and were later members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
